lessonTitle: 50. A line perpendicular to a plane
lessonTitleEnglish: A line perpendicular to a plane
unit: Geometry · Chapter II. Perpendicularity, distances and angles
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A line is perpendicular to a plane if it is perpendicular to every line of the plane.
stages.headlineEnglish: A line is perpendicular to a plane if it is perpendicular to every line of the plane.

stages.headline: Test: a line perpendicular to two intersecting lines of a plane is perpendicular to the plane.
stages.headlineEnglish: Test: a line perpendicular to two intersecting lines of a plane is perpendicular to the plane.

stages.headline: Two lines perpendicular to the same plane are parallel: in the cube AA₁ ⊥ (ABCD), CC₁ ⊥ (ABCD), so AA₁ ∥ CC₁.
stages.headlineEnglish: Two lines perpendicular to the same plane are parallel: in the cube AA₁ ⊥ (ABCD), CC₁ ⊥ (ABCD), so AA₁ ∥ CC₁.
